scope: Committed development-only component fixture, actual consent/chart/camera components, synthetic in-memory identity, no API credentials

observations.name: Initial placeholders: no consent, no provider requests
Explicit chart load admits one intercepted TradingView frame
Explicit camera load uses YouTube nocookie only
Explicit IPCamLive load admits its intercepted frame
Withdrawal removes all open provider frames
Reload after withdrawal admits no provider
Memory remembering writes no browser preference
New camera waits for Play despite remembered provider

Privacy settings withdrawal removes the frame and saved key
Reload after saved-choice withdrawal blocks all providers
360px keyboard Load admits one camera without overflow

harnessNotes: The first combined run stopped at settings withdrawal with unchanged state. A fresh DOM snapshot and the CLI click targeting the observed settings-list button removed the iframe and saved key. This is retained as a harness observation; no application defect was established.
sanitisation: Origin and pathname only. Query strings, fragments, headers, cookies, request/response bodies and storage values excluded.
